prompts.name: alpine-grass
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high resolution landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot concept for a modern 2D Scorched Earth artillery game. Strict orthographic SIDE VIEW, all gameplay on one 2D plane; NOT isometric, not perspective terrain, not a cinematic painting. A large continuous solid destructible terrain cross-section fills the lower 45 percent of the frame, with highly legible silhouette, fine crisp edges and layered earth/rock cutaway texture extending to bottom edge. Air and distant atmospheric background fill the upper part. Modern illustrated indie game art, restrained painterly textures within crisp shapes, subtle lighting, readable and feasible in Canvas2D. Two tiny distinct tanks, cyan and orange, with long barrels, perched on separate clear firing platforms, each about 2 percent of image width. Foreground scenery correctly scaled to tanks. One small glowing projectile with a short delicate trail, not a giant explosion. Minimal slim dark navy HUD strip across top, exact text 'POWER 500' 'ANGLE 45°' 'PLAYER 1' 'BABY MISSILE' and a small wind arrow. Small unobtrusive caption at lower left 'TERRAIN CONCEPT'. No menus, no mobile buttons, no branding or watermark. This is a terrain gameplay mockup, emphasize playable landforms and destructibility. Grassy alpine mountain battlefield: rolling emerald foothills rise to a tall central rocky peak with snow caps and irregular snow on ledges; a lower pass allows artillery trajectories. Grass turf is thin above warm layered brown soil and cool grey stone. Sparse small conifers, a tiny wooden house, a small deer away from tanks. One fresh semicircular shell crater reveals stratified dirt. Pale blue sky, soft clouds and distant hazy mountain layers. Broad open air above the highest peak. Bright clear late-morning atmosphere.
